changes: Full, light and minimal public entries now use an independently written reader/writer, message reflection, schema loader/parser and application descriptor conversion runtime.
Preserve reader bounds on errors, validate lengths and varint widths, protect shared zero, and preserve prototype-named fields as own data.
Preserve exact 64-bit values through vlong, explicit presence, negative zero, closed enums, unknown fields and repeated singular-message merging.
Constructors and scalar/repeated/map/nested codecs specialize fixed, validated templates once; enum/group codecs and environments blocking dynamic functions retain the checked interpreter.
Align the package version with the 8.8.1 API comparison target; public declarations describe implemented APIs.
Retain upstream compatibility source and generated schema data with their original license; public application runtime imports do not load src/.
Reduce short-string conversion, writer allocation and length-delimiter overhead without removing bounds, UTF-8, enum or prototype-safety checks.
Restore short service-name lookup needed by the actual GAX fallback caller while preserving descriptor qualification.

Recognize prefixed bundled Google schema paths in Node and browser loaders; canonicalize aliases, honor custom resolvers and skip declined paths. Full Firestore conformance verifies pipeline/explain loading.
Cache namespace child lists with invalidation on mutation and use direct child properties to reduce schema construction allocations; preserve reflection checks and avoid shared cross-root state.

implementation.kind: independent application runtime with retained internal compatibility
implementation.basis: runtime/*.cjs and public declarations are independently written around native typed arrays, DataView, TextEncoder/TextDecoder and vlong. runtime/common.json and google/ contain retained protocol schema data. src/, src/compatibility.d.ts, ext/descriptor-compat.js, optional legacy extensions and generated descriptor declarations retain upstream provenance.
implementation.targetScope: Generated message readers/writers, reflection encode/decode/conversion/verification, proto2/proto3 and tested edition features, JSON/.proto loading, descriptors used by actual proto-loader, GAX and Firestore.
implementation.remainingWork: Separate CLI/compiler/decorator APIs, comment/source metadata and advanced edition/descriptor tooling are not implemented or claimed by the public runtime. Legacy src/ and optional ProtoJSON/text-format/debug extension source remain upstream-derived compatibility code. This package has not been released or adopted by the application.

independentComponents.runtime: Independent public application runtime; tests assert that the full/light/minimal and descriptor entries do not import retained src/ code.
independentComponents.index.d.ts: Declarations authored for the implemented public API, rather than the full upstream tooling surface.

scope: Independent application-used Protocol Buffers runtime for generated Google messages, proto-loader, GAX and Firestore; retained optional tooling and internal compatibility source is outside the completed scope.
